announcements.headline: Q3 2026 Trading Update and Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: In a high-yield sector where capital preservation is paramount, this update signals management's commitment to dividend stability despite potential interest rate headwinds, reinforcing RGL's positioning as a defensive income play amidst UK retail property volatility.
